description: Delete SEVERAL fields in ONE call — whenever the person asks to remove more than one field, or to keep only some fields of a table (pass every field that goes). The fields may be of one table or of several. The person confirms them all on one card; nothing is removed before that. Every field must exist, or nothing is removed and the answer names the table's real fields. Irreversible — the data in these fields is lost.

fields.description: Each field that goes: its table and the field by name or by its full id

field_id.description: The field's full ID from get_form_fields

name: delete_fields
